title: Holiday Grades Jam Announcement!
body:
Holiday Grades Jam is Here!

Make a grades by Thanksgiving at midnight for a chance to be featured! The winner of the Halloween Grades Jam was FrigedRaccoon with Pumpkin Clicker! Don't miss your chance to be featured and make a grades! (Try out the Construct Grades Engine if you're unsure where to start!)

Rules

  • Make a grades by Thanksgiving at midnight
  • Holiday themed (Any holiday in November-December)
  • Single-player

Submit your grades to CCPorted.
